articles.summary: When it comes to making purchases in today’s environment, the data is clear – consumers like options. According to a recent online survey conducted by CPI® of more than 2,000 consumers, respondents stated they preferred the choice to use either physical cards or digital payment solutions when making purchases. The survey also showed that while digital payments are on the rise and an appreciated option – especially among a younger demographic – physical card use remains the most popular option.
